title: Nothing Left to Betray
description: You stopped asking what it would cost long ago. There's no one left who trusts you enough to be disappointed.

title: The Weight of Being Right
description: You never once compromised. It cost you every relationship that needed you to bend, even a little.

title: The Last Envelope
description: There's nothing left to sell and no one left to borrow from. You did this to yourself, one reasonable choice at a time.

title: A Very Comfortable Cage
description: You have more money than you'll ever need, and no memory of the last time someone wanted something from you besides it.

title: No One to Call
description: The people who might have shown up have stopped waiting for you to need them.

title: Everyone's Favor to Cash
description: You said yes to all of them, every time, for years. You can't remember the last decision that was only yours.

title: Static
description: Somewhere back along the line, the decisions stopped feeling like yours to make.

title: Nothing Touches You Now
description: You built enough control around yourself that nothing gets in anymore. Nothing gets out, either.

title: The Debt Collector
description: The deal you made to get ahead finally came due, and it took the last person still willing to stand near you.

title: Sole Proprietor
description: You own all of it now — every share, every decision, every empty office after everyone else has gone home.

title: What Was Left of You
description: You gave everything to keep her safe. You're not sure there's a version of you left that exists outside of that.

title: Visiting Hours
description: You made the practical choice. The people who loved you both never quite forgave you for it, including yourself.

title: Every Day, Whether They Want To or Not
description: You won everything you fought for. Nobody in your house would say it feels like winning.
